summary: Attempted to verify the dashboard mock data implementation at http://localhost:8080. The application failed to load, remaining on a blank white screen despite several minutes of waiting and multiple refresh attempts. Console logs revealed a repetitive script loading loop. Tested both localhost and 127.0.0.1 with identical results. The browser also crashed/closed during interactions, suggesting potential server-side or environment-specific issues. Data verification was not possible as the dashboard did not render.
